scripts.title: Noclip Script For Any Game
scripts.features: Noclip in any game
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local noclip = false

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
		noclip = not noclip
		print("Noclip:", noclip and "ON" or "OFF")
	end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if not player.Character then return end

	for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = not noclip
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Silent Aim
scripts.features: Automatically redirects arrows towards nearest player in your fov
scripts.script:
local Config = {
    FOVSize = 180,
    HitPart = "Head",
    MaxFlightTicks = 100,
    FullDrawTicks = 20,
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Client = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Client")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")

local BowController = require(Client:WaitForChild("BowController"))
local CombatClient = require(Client:WaitForChild("CombatClient"))
local FirstPersonAnimationModule = Client:WaitForChild("FirstPersonAnimation")
local FirstPersonAnimation = require(FirstPersonAnimationModule)
local TaCZMotion = require(FirstPersonAnimationModule:WaitForChild("TaCZMotion"))
local BowMath = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BowMath"))
local BowNet = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BowNet"))
local BowConfig = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BowConfig"))
local CharacterLife = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CharacterLife"))

local ActiveRelease = nil
local ActivePreview = nil
local ActiveDrawingController = nil
local CachedDraws = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

if Drawing and type(Drawing.new) == "function" then
    local FovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
    FovCircle.Position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    FovCircle.Visible = true
    FovCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    FovCircle.Radius = Config.FOVSize
    FovCircle.Transparency = 1
    FovCircle.Filled = false
    FovCircle.NumSides = 64

    RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
        FovCircle.Position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    end)
end

local function FindTarget()
    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then
        return nil
    end

    local Mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local BestPart = nil
    local BestDistance = Config.FOVSize
    local InfectionMode = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MatchMode") == "Infection"

    local function Consider(Character, Player)
        if not Character or Character.Name == "DeathModel" then
            return
        end
        if InfectionMode then
            local RoleSource = Player or Character
            if RoleSource:GetAttribute("InfectionRole") ~= "Zombie" then
                return
            end
        end
        if Player and Player:GetAttribute("MatchStatus") == "Dead" then
            return
        end

        local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not Humanoid
            or CharacterLife.isDead(Humanoid)
            or Humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        then
            return
        end

        local Part = Character:FindFirstChild(Config.HitPart)
        if not Part or not Part:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        local Screen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Part.Position)
        if Screen.Z <= 0 then
            return
        end

        local Distance = (Vector2.new(Screen.X, Screen.Y) - Mouse).Magnitude
        if Distance >= BestDistance then
            return
        end

        BestDistance = Distance
        BestPart = Part
    end

    for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
        if Player == LocalPlayer then
            continue
        end

        Consider(Player.Character, Player)
    end

    local Bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
    if Bots then
        for _, Bot in Bots:GetChildren() do
            if not Bot:IsA("Model") then
                continue
            end

            Consider(Bot)
        end
    end

    return BestPart
end

local function SolveDirection(Controller, Origin, ChargeTicks, Target)
    local Seed = Controller.network and Controller.network.bowSeed
    local DrawId = Controller.drawId
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Root = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not Seed or not DrawId or not Root or not Target or ChargeTicks == nil then
        return nil, "missing seed, draw ID, character root, target, or charge"
    end

    local Power = BowMath.powerTicks(ChargeTicks)
    if Power < 0.1 then
        return nil, "draw charge is below launch threshold"
    end

    local Effects = Controller.drawEffects
    local SpeedBonus = 1 + (Effects and Effects.ArrowSpeedBonus or 0)
    local Speed = BowMath.f32(Power * 3 * SpeedBonus)
    if Speed <= 0 then
        return nil, "launch speed is zero"
    end

    local Spread = BowMath.launchSpread(BowNet.random(Seed, DrawId))
    local Source = BowMath.fromWorld(BowNet.clampVelocity(Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) * BowConfig.Tick)
    local OriginBlocks = BowMath.fromWorld(Origin)
    local TargetVelocity = Target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local Drag = BowMath.AirInertia

    local function Candidate(Ticks)
        local Sum = (1 - Drag ^ Ticks) / (1 - Drag)
        local GravityDrop = 0.05 * (Ticks - Sum) / (1 - Drag)
        local Future = Target.Position + TargetVelocity * (Ticks * BowConfig.Tick)
        local Destination = BowMath.fromWorld(Future)
        local Delta = Vector3.new(
            Destination.x - OriginBlocks.x,
            Destination.y - OriginBlocks.y,
            Destination.z - OriginBlocks.z
        )
        local RequiredVelocity = Vector3.new(
            Delta.X / Sum,
            (Delta.Y + GravityDrop) / Sum,
            Delta.Z / Sum
        )
        local Aim = Vector3.new(
            (RequiredVelocity.X - Source.x) / Speed - Spread.x,
            RequiredVelocity.Y / Speed - Spread.y,
            (RequiredVelocity.Z - Source.z) / Speed - Spread.z
        )
        return Aim, Aim.Magnitude - 1
    end

    local PreviousTicks = 0.25
    local _, PreviousError = Candidate(PreviousTicks)
    local BestAim = nil
    local BestTicks = nil
    local BestError = math.huge

    for Ticks = 0.5, Config.MaxFlightTicks, 0.5 do
        local Aim, Error = Candidate(Ticks)
        if math.abs(Error) < BestError then
            BestAim = Aim
            BestTicks = Ticks
            BestError = math.abs(Error)
        end

        if PreviousError > 0 and Error <= 0 then
            local Low, High = PreviousTicks, Ticks
            for _ = 1, 18 do
                local Mid = (Low + High) * 0.5
                local _, MidError = Candidate(Mid)
                if MidError > 0 then
                    Low = Mid
                else
                    High = Mid
                end
            end
            Aim = Candidate((Low + High) * 0.5)
            if Aim.Magnitude > 0 then
                return Aim.Unit, nil, {
                    FlightTicks = (Low + High) * 0.5,
                    Power = Power,
                    Speed = Speed,
                    Spread = Spread,
                    Source = Source,
                    Fallback = false,
                }
            end
            return nil, "aim vector is zero"
        end

        PreviousTicks = Ticks
        PreviousError = Error
    end

    if not BestAim or BestAim.Magnitude <= 0 then
        return nil, "no usable trajectory"
    end

    return BestAim.Unit, nil, {
        FlightTicks = BestTicks,
        Power = Power,
        Speed = Speed,
        Spread = Spread,
        Source = Source,
        Fallback = true,
        Residual = BestError,
    }
end

local OldChargeTicks
OldChargeTicks = hookfunction(BowNet.chargeTicks, function(...)
    local Ticks = OldChargeTicks(...)
    if ActiveRelease then
        ActiveRelease.ChargeTicks = Ticks
    end
    return Ticks
end)

local OldRandom
OldRandom = hookfunction(BowNet.random, function(Seed, DrawId)
    local Controller = ActivePreview
    if not Controller or (type(Seed) == "number" and type(DrawId) == "number") then
        return OldRandom(Seed, DrawId)
    end

    local Cached = CachedDraws[Controller]
    local CurrentId = Controller.drawId
    if type(CurrentId) ~= "number" and Cached then
        CurrentId = Cached.Id
    end

    if type(Seed) == "number" and type(CurrentId) == "number" then
        DrawId = CurrentId
        Controller.previewDrawId = DrawId
        return OldRandom(Seed, DrawId)
    end

    Controller.trajectory:hide()
    return function()
        return 0.5
    end
end)

local OldPreviewTrajectory
OldPreviewTrajectory = hookfunction(BowController.previewTrajectory, function(Controller, ...)
    if Controller.drawing and (not Controller.network or type(Controller.network.bowSeed) ~= "number") then
        Controller.trajectory:hide()
        return
    end

    if Controller.drawing and type(Controller.drawId) ~= "number" then
        local Cached = CachedDraws[Controller]
        if Cached and type(Cached.Id) == "number" then
            Controller.drawId = Cached.Id
        else
            Controller.trajectory:hide()
            return
        end
    end

    local Previous = ActivePreview
    ActivePreview = Controller
    local Result = OldPreviewTrajectory(Controller, ...)
    ActivePreview = Previous
    return Result
end)

local OldLaunchPoint
OldLaunchPoint = hookfunction(BowController.launchPoint, function(Controller, ...)
    local Origin, Direction = OldLaunchPoint(Controller, ...)
    local State = ActiveRelease
    local IsRelease = State and State.Controller == Controller
    local IsPreview = ActivePreview == Controller and Controller.drawing
    if not IsRelease and not IsPreview then
        return Origin, Direction
    end

    local Target = FindTarget()
    if not Target then
        return Origin, Direction
    end

    local ChargeTicks = if IsRelease then State.ChargeTicks else Controller.previewTicks
    local Aim = SolveDirection(Controller, Origin, ChargeTicks, Target)
    if Aim then
        if IsRelease then
            State.Direction = Aim
            State.Origin = Origin
        end
        return Origin, Aim
    end
    return Origin, Direction
end)

local OldSend
OldSend = hookfunction(CombatClient.send, function(Network, Action, Params)
    local State = ActiveRelease
    local Matched = Action == "Release" and State and State.Controller.network == Network
    if Matched and State.Direction then
        Params.direction = State.Direction
        Params.origin = State.Origin
    end
    local Result = OldSend(Network, Action, Params)
    if Action == "Draw" and Network.controller then
        CachedDraws[Network.controller] = {Id = Result}
    end
    return Result
end)

local OldBeginDraw
OldBeginDraw = hookfunction(BowController.beginDraw, function(Controller, ...)
    local WasDrawing = Controller.drawing
    local Result = OldBeginDraw(Controller, ...)
    if WasDrawing or not Controller.drawing then
        return Result
    end

    ActiveDrawingController = Controller
    return Result
end)

local OldAnimationUpdate
OldAnimationUpdate = hookfunction(FirstPersonAnimation.update, function(Animation, Delta, Slot, Drawing, DrawTicks, ...)
    local Controller = ActiveDrawingController
    if Controller and Controller.firstPersonAnimation == Animation and Drawing and Slot == 1 then
        DrawTicks = math.max(DrawTicks, Config.FullDrawTicks)
    end

    return OldAnimationUpdate(Animation, Delta, Slot, Drawing, DrawTicks, ...)
end)

local OldMotionUpdate
OldMotionUpdate = hookfunction(TaCZMotion.update, function(Motion, Delta, Drawing, DrawTicks, ...)
    local Result = OldMotionUpdate(Motion, Delta, Drawing, DrawTicks, ...)
    local Controller = ActiveDrawingController
    if Controller and Controller.firstPersonAnimation.tacz == Motion and Drawing and Motion.key == "tb23" then
        local Track = Motion.adsTrack
        if Track and Track.name == "pull_in" then
            Track.start = math.min(Track.start, Motion.clock - 0.2)
        end
    end

    return Result
end)

local OldRelease
OldRelease = hookfunction(BowController.release, function(Controller, ...)
    local Previous = ActiveRelease
    local State = {Controller = Controller}
    ActiveRelease = State
    local Result = OldRelease(Controller, ...)
    ActiveRelease = Previous
    return Result
end)

local function tween(obj, props, dur)
    Tween:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(dur or 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

local function addHover(btn, base, hover)

    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)

    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 2
    knob.Parent = track_
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 24)
    hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -17)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.ZIndex = 3
    hit.Parent = track_

    local current = default

    local function set(v, updateBox)
        v = tonumber(v)
        if not v then v = current end
        v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
        current = v
        local t = (max == min) and 0 or (v - min) / (max - min)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(t, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(t, 0, 0.5, 0)
        if updateBox ~= false then box.Text = string.format("%.2f", v) end
        local ok, err = pcall(callback, v)
        if not ok then warn("[Boombox] slider callback:", err) end
    end

    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local function update(i)
                local rel = (i.Position.X - track_.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track_.AbsoluteSize.X)
                rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
                set(min + rel * (max - min), true)
            end
            activeDrag = update
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if enter then set(box.Text, true) end
    end)

    set(default, true)
    return { set = set, get = function() return current end, frame = row }
end

local function normalizeId(raw)
    raw = (raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if tonumber(raw) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. raw
    end
    if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then return raw end
    if raw:match("^https?://") then
        local id = raw:match("(%d+)")
        if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
    end
    return raw
end

local function ensureSound()
    if state.sound and state.sound.Parent then return state.sound end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BoomboxSound"
    s.Looped = state.looped
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Parent = SoundService
    state.sound = s
    return s
end

local function stopSound()
    if state.sound then
        state.sound:Stop()
        state.sound:Destroy()
        state.sound = nil
    end
    state.playing = false
end

local function playSound()
    if state.soundId == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a music id first.")
        return
    end
    stopSound()
    local s = ensureSound()
    s.SoundId = state.soundId
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Looped = state.looped
    local ok, err = pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    if not ok then
        setStatus("Playback failed.")
        return
    end
    state.playing = true
    setStatus("Playing.")
end

local function pauseSound()
    if state.sound and state.playing then
        state.sound:Pause()
        state.playing = false
        setStatus("Paused.")
    end
end

local function resumeSound()
    if state.sound and not state.playing then
        state.sound:Resume()
        state.playing = true
        setStatus("Resumed.")
    end
end

local function registerTab(name, icon, buildFn)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
    btn.LayoutOrder = #tabs + 1
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Btn
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    btn.Text = "   " .. icon .. "   " .. name
    btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    btn.Parent = sideScroll
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local page = makePage(content)
    buildFn(page)

    local entry = { name = name, btn = btn, page = page }
    tabs[#tabs + 1] = entry

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if entry.page.Visible then return end
        tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.BtnHi})
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if entry.page.Visible then return end
        tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Btn})
    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
            local sel = (t == entry)
            t.page.Visible = sel
            tween(t.btn, {
                BackgroundColor3 = sel and Theme.Accent or Theme.Btn,
                BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0.15 or 0.55,
            }, 0.18)
            t.btn.TextColor3 = sel and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.Text
        end
    end)

    return entry
end

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = panel.Position
    end
end)

track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        panel.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end))

track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end))

local minimized = false
local expandedSize = panel.Size
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    if minimized then
        expandedSize = panel.Size
        sidebar.Visible = false
        content.Visible = false
        footer.Visible = false
        panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(panel.AbsoluteSize.X, HEADER_H)
        minBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        sidebar.Visible = true
        content.Visible = true
        footer.Visible = true
        panel.Size = expandedSize
        minBtn.Text = "–"
    end
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    print("[BoomboxMusic] Closed.  Made by N00XC, ScriptBlox and Roblox")
end)

track(UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled
    end
end))

setStatus("Boombox ready.")
print("[BoomboxMusic] Ready.  Made by N00XC, ScriptBlox and Roblox")

scripts.script:
--[[
    Anti-Kick Universal Script
    Funciona em: Synapse, Krnl, Fluxus, Delta, Hydrogen, etc.
    Ativa automaticamente ao executar
]]

-- Configurações
local config = {
    antiKick = true,        -- Bloqueia kicks
    antiDisconnect = true,  -- Bloqueia desconexões forçadas
    antiTeleport = true,    -- Bloqueia teleportes forçados
    notify = true,          -- Notifica quando algo for bloqueado
}

-- Serviços
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Detectar executor
local executor = "Desconhecido"
if syn then executor = "Synapse"
elseif KRNL_LOADED then executor = "Krnl"
elseif Fluxus then executor = "Fluxus"
elseif identifyexecutor then executor = pcall(function() executor = identifyexecutor() end)
end

-- Função de notificação
local function notify(title, text)
    if not config.notify then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title,
            Text = text,
            Duration = 3,
        })
    end)
end

-- Bloquear Kick
local oldKick
oldKick = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Kick, function(self, message)
    if config.antiKick then
        notify("Anti-Kick", "Kick bloqueado: " .. tostring(message))
        return
    end
    return oldKick(self, message)
end)

-- Bloquear Disconnect (método alternativo)
local oldDisconnect
if LocalPlayer.Disconnect then
    oldDisconnect = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Disconnect, function(self)
        if config.antiDisconnect then
            notify("Anti-Kick", "Disconnect bloqueado")
            return
        end
        return oldDisconnect(self)
    end)
end

-- Proteção contra Teleport forçado
local oldTeleport
if LocalPlayer.Teleport then
    oldTeleport = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Teleport, function(self, ...)
        if config.antiTeleport then
            notify("Anti-Teleport", "Teleporte bloqueado")
            return
        end
        return oldTeleport(self, ...)
    end)
end

-- Detectar e bloquear via RemoteEvents (tentativa de kick por servidor)
local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall

setreadonly(mt, false)
mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    local args = {...}
    
    if config.antiKick then
        -- Bloqueia kicks vindos do servidor via remotes comuns
        if method == "Fire" or method == "InvokeServer" then
            if self.Name == "Kick" or self.Name == "Disconnect" then
                notify("Anti-Kick", "Tentativa de kick via remote bloqueada")
                return
            end
        end
    end
    
    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end)
setreadonly(mt, true)

-- Notificação inicial
notify("Anti-Kick", "Ativado com sucesso! (" .. executor .. ")")

-- Loop de proteção contínua (re-aplica hooks se necessário)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(5) do
        pcall(function()
            if config.antiKick and not hookmetamethod then
                -- Re-hook básico caso algo tenha resetado
            end
        end)
    end
end)

print("[Anti-Kick] Script carregado | Executor: " .. executor)
